description: Adding the constraint \(q\Rightarrow\bot\) to the seeded cycle leaves closure \(\{p,q\}\) but gives no models; a different atom \(r\) is outside the closure and nevertheless belongs to every model vacuously.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.inconsistent_cycle :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.closure Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.inconsistentCycle =
      {Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.Atom.p, Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.Atom.q} ∧
    (¬∃ X, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.models Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.inconsistentCycle X) ∧
      Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.Atom.r ∉
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.closure Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.inconsistentCycle ∧
        ∀ (X : Set Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.Atom),
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.models Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.inconsistentCycle X →
            Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.Atom.r ∈ X
